verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents multiple autonomous background automations: syncs run on a schedule or trigger without manual intervention (hightouch-docs-3, hightouch-docs-20), automated journeys (hightouch-docs-19), and AI Decisioning 'agents' that combine audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules and guardrails and use reinforcement learning to continuously choose message/channel/timing and measure results (hightouch-docs-46, hightouch-docs-45, hightouch-docs-14) — a clear autonomous background automation capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming these automations reliably run unattended over time, and more detail on failure/guardrail handling in production beyond docs claims.
